column2: [intro]
In my closet, sparkly clothes
Colorful shoes, even if it's not quite right
I don't care about the look, the ultimate elegance
I just want to be funky, no fashion prime
I want to talk about trivialities
Let's forget worries and realities
When life becomes too sad and dull
I take refuge in the world of trivialities
On my couch, I zap non-stop
Stupid shows to forget regrets
When reality becomes too overwhelming
I disconnect, I escape into my vibrant bubble
In my world, we talk about trivialities
Useless gadgets and frivolity
When problems pile up, life treats us badly
I dive into the world of trivialities
[ solo ]
